rationale: The blind translation faithfully reconstructs the absolute constants, nonempty finite family, probability-space assumptions, finite exponential-moment gauge, common maximum scale, componentwise MGF bound, and all positive-K quantifier dependencies. Its product window is exactly equivalent to Equation (2.24) when the family maximum K is positive. At K=0 it deliberately supplies the natural full-window extension, whereas the source's real quotient is undefined and no degenerate clause is printed. Thus translation implies the meaningful source claim, while the source does not state the full translated extension: faithful-stronger. Adjudication remains necessary because the source leaves its zero-maximum convention unresolved.
